items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: when I was at Nick's in New York... Nick played piano... so he could come and sit in and play.

ctx.x: A lot of things I hear him do I hear on records by other guys, I think. Oh yeah. I think the Chicago guys picked something from him.

He originated that false fingering on clarinet. And when I was at Nick's in New York, Nick used to tell me that his two favorite clarinet players were Sidney Ayrton and myself, because Sidney had worked there for quite a while. And well, Fasola he went without saying, you know, everybody liked him.
Did Nick ever play with the band much?
